scientific_questions: Can real standardized EE-position plus joint counterfactual differences predict real CLIP visual counterfactual differences?
Does candidate-independent pre-action scene context add significant held-out predictive value?
How much of a successful real-physical mapping remains after substituting the frozen calibrated WM-v2B.1 physical prediction?

reports_results_tree.scope: Every .md/.json/.csv/.yaml/.yml path tracked below docs/ and results/ at the tag; digest is SHA-256 over path, NUL, current file SHA-256, newline in git tree order.

partitions.block_rule: All three pairs and eight horizons from one branch point remain in one partition and one bootstrap block.

sample_contract.physical_real: train-standardized real_p_i[h]-real_p_j[h], restricted to ee_pos indices 0:3 and joint indices 5:12
sample_contract.physical_predicted: frozen WM-v2B predicted standardized delta_i-delta_j, multiplied by frozen WM-v2B.1 per-horizon alpha, then restricted to the same ten EE+joint dimensions

context.source: frozen WM-v2B initial_hidden output before the GRU
context.candidate_identity_test: repeat each bitwise-verified common pre-action input three times through the frozen extractor; maximum absolute c0 difference <=1e-7

probes.selection: leave-one-init-out CV within init 31-34; minimize arithmetic mean fold RMSE; exact tie selects the larger alpha
probes.p1: no-bias mean-loss ridge Linear(10,512); exactly antisymmetric
probes.p2: mean-loss ridge Linear(256,512) with unpenalized intercept; context-only diagnostic and deliberately strong baseline

p3.loss: mean squared error on raw 512-D visual difference
p3.final_epoch_rule: round-half-up median of four inner-fold best epochs, then train once on all init 31-34 without evaluation early stopping

metrics.primary: RMSE(predicted visual difference, real visual difference)
metrics.direction: cosine(predicted visual difference, real visual difference); zero prediction is assigned direction 0
separation: pair-of-pair ordering accuracy with ties worth 0.5

negative_controls.scope: held-out evaluation only; P3 parameters remain frozen
negative_controls.physical_shuffle: within-task fixed-seed branch-point derangement; preserve pair and horizon; keep context and target fixed
negative_controls.context_shuffle: within-task fixed-seed branch-point derangement; keep real physical delta and target fixed

bootstrap.unit: task-stratified held-out branch point; resample four branch points with replacement within each task and retain all pairs, horizons, and coordinates

gates.p1_sufficient: improvement over zero CI lower >0; direction point and CI lower >0; every pair direction point >0; norm ratio-of-means in [0.25,4]
gates.p3_real_pass: improvement over zero CI lower >0; improvement over both P1 and P2 >=5% with CI lower >0; aggregate direction and CI lower >0; every pair direction >0; both fixed shuffles significantly worsen RMSE and direction; norm ratio-of-means in [0.25,4]
gates.shuffle_significant: relative RMSE degradation CI lower >0 and direction degradation CI lower >0
gates.p3_predicted_pass: improvement over zero CI lower >0; improvement over P2 >=5% with CI lower >0; aggregate direction and CI lower >0; every pair direction >0; norm ratio-of-means in [0.25,4]
decision_order: P3 real pass plus P3 predicted pass -> also CONTEXT_CONDITIONED_DEPLOYABLE_MEDIATOR_CONFIRMED
P3 real pass plus P3 predicted fail -> also PHYSICAL_MEDIATOR_ACCURACY_REMAINS_BOTTLENECK
otherwise P1 pass and P3 lacks significant >=5% gain over P1 -> PHYSICAL_ONLY_VISUAL_MAPPING_SUFFICIENT and BLOCK_CONTEXT_CONDITIONED_WM_DESIGN
otherwise P3 lacks significant >=5% gain over P2 and physical shuffle does not significantly worsen -> CONTEXT_DOMINATES_PHYSICAL_SIGNAL_NOT_ADDITIVE and BLOCK
any provenance, split, finite, identity, or implementation failure before metrics -> DATA_OR_IMPLEMENTATION_BLOCK

forbidden: read init 36-39 values before the calibration freeze and weight hash are committed
rerun the simulator when the frozen sidecars already contain the required real futures
train or modify any World Model, CLIP encoder, C0 actor, candidate generator, production scale, reranker, controller, C1, C2, or D20-v2
use gripper, action identity, candidate identity, pair identity embedding, candidate score, expert-action error, noise seed, reward, done, success, or task outcome as probe inputs
use future RGB, future proprio, future object state, or candidate outcome as context
select architecture, hidden size, ridge alpha, epoch, target, threshold, or verdict gate from init 36-39
train seed23/47 or overwrite an upstream artifact
